page.overview:
What is Longo Baggins?

Longo Baggins was the third child of Mungo and Laura Baggins and the uncle of Bilbo Baggins.

Longo married Camellia Sackville and as a result sired the Sackville-Baggins family with the birth of their son, Otho.
